transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before we lock the telemetry pipeline policy and proceed to production enablement, I need to follow the go-live checklist. Could the security owner and the platform finance owner each confirm that our data-handling and operating-cost requirements are met? Specifically, the current draft has 100 percent sampling, 30-day retention, and raw event payload storage — I want to make sure both of those areas are cleared before I make the binding decision.

transcript.text: During a privacy review this morning, I confirmed that production events contain tax_id and bank_account fields in three event types. Our approved data-handling rule requires both fields to be redacted before storage, requires raw payload storage to be disabled, and requires production telemetry to remain enabled once those controls are applied. I have not yet filed this finding in the launch ticket.
